mapper.select: SELECT id, constructionIdx, deviceId, versionNo, CONCAT('V', LPAD(versionNo, 3, '0')) AS version, DATE_FORMAT(createdAt, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS createdAt, workType FROM TB_DEVICE_BACKUP_HISTORY WHERE constructionIdx = #{constructionIdx} AND deviceId = #{deviceId} ORDER BY versionNo DESC, id DESC

SELECT id, constructionIdx, deviceId, versionNo, CONCAT('V', LPAD(versionNo, 3, '0')) AS version, DATE_FORMAT(createdAt, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS createdAt, workType, snapshotData FROM TB_DEVICE_BACKUP_HISTORY WHERE id = #{id} AND constructionIdx = #{constructionIdx} AND deviceId = #{deviceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_DEVICE_BACKUP_HISTORY (constructionIdx, deviceId, versionNo, createdAt, workType, snapshotData) SELECT #{constructionIdx}, #{deviceId}, COALESCE(MAX(versionNo), 0) + 1, NOW(), #{workType}, #{snapshotData} FROM TB_DEVICE_BACKUP_HISTORY WHERE deviceId = #{deviceId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM TB_REPORT WHERE deviceIdx = #{deviceId} AND isDel = 0 ORDER BY createDate ASC, id ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM TB_PIECE WHERE reportIdx IN ( SELECT id FROM TB_REPORT WHERE deviceIdx = #{deviceId} AND isDel = 0 )
DELETE FROM TB_PENETRATION WHERE reportIdx IN ( SELECT id FROM TB_REPORT WHERE deviceIdx = #{deviceId} AND isDel = 0 )
